comments.author: bay.reid@aethertech.com
comments.body: We have attempted to reproduce the issue on an iPhone 13 running iOS 15.2. Steps taken: cleared app cache, performed password reset, verified credentials. Issue persists.

comments.author: bay.reid@aethertech.com
comments.body: Proposed fix: resolve the iOS login bug in the next sprint (target date 2024-11-14).

comments.author: aisha.ndlovu@learnmate.com
comments.body: Please advise if there is any workaround. This is affecting my coursework.

description: Aisha Ndlovu reported that after resetting her password she is unable to log into the LearnMate iOS app on iOS 15.2. The login screen returns an authentication error. She is a sophomore at Colorado State University and uses the app for coursework.
summary: User cannot log into LearnMate iOS app after password reset
